cinzel.cues: all caps, flared wedge serifs, carved-stone proportions, wide letters
cinzel.fits: epic and mythic fantasy, dark fantasy, ancient history, prestige drama

playfair.cues: very thin hairlines against heavy stems, ball terminals, fashion-magazine feel
playfair.fits: period drama, mystery, luxury, literary and cinematic titles

slab.cues: heavy block serifs, sturdy and mechanical, western or industrial feel
slab.fits: westerns, crime, industrial and survival settings, trucks and machines

medieval.cues: pointed calligraphic strokes, playful and readable, tavern-sign feel
medieval.fits: whimsical fantasy, folklore, tavern and adventure games, tabletop

gothic.cues: broken, angular blackletter strokes, dense texture; unreadable in all caps
gothic.fits: gothic horror, vampires, metal, grimdark, religious-occult themes

typewriter.cues: even-width typed letters with slab serifs, case-file or dossier feel
typewriter.fits: psychological and modern horror, true crime, mystery, espionage, found footage

bebas.cues: narrow, tall, uniform-weight caps; poster and trailer feel

oswald.cues: narrow sans with some weight contrast, newspaper-headline feel
oswald.fits: news, explainers, sports analysis, history channels

teko.cues: squarish rounded-rectangle bowls, mid-width and heavy, scoreboard feel
teko.fits: esports, racing, sports games, shooters, fitness

rajdhani.cues: flat-sided squared letters, lighter and wider than teko, engineering-UI feel
rajdhani.fits: tech, hardware, benchmarks, near-future sci-fi, cyberpunk UI

orbitron.fits: space, sci-fi shooters, synthwave, futuristic tech

outfit.cues: round geometric bowls, clean and neutral, app and brand feel
outfit.fits: tech brands, apps, gadgets, startups, clean modern titles

nunito.cues: rounded terminals, soft and warm, toy-like
nunito.fits: cozy games, family and kids titles, lifestyle

stencil.cues: heavy stencil cuts, chamfered corners, crate-and-ammo feel

pixel.cues: blocky bitmap letters on a pixel grid
pixel.fits: retro and indie pixel-art games, arcade, speedrunning classics

brush.cues: slanted hand-lettered marker strokes, friendly and energetic; poor in all caps
brush.fits: street, skate, surf, travel, food, vlogs
